artworks.title: Conradus Detleu von Dehn
artworks.artist: François Chereau I after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in an angled stance, looking at the viewer. He has distinct facial features, including a long nose, thin lips, and slightly wary eyes. He has long, curly hair framing his face, and is wearing elaborate clothing with ornate patterns, ruffled sleeves, and a large collar. He has a hand resting on a helmet placed on a table next to him. In the background, there are large columns and possibly a decorative wall or curtain.

artworks.title: Jean-Baptiste Santeuil
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after Chevalier Dumee
artworks.description: The engraving depicts an upper-body portrait of a seated man facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. The man has curly dark hair, a slightly smiling expression, and wears a robe, high-collared shirt, a ribbon tie, and a fur-lined cloak. His right hand holds a hat, while his left hand rests on a paper on the desk holding a quill. In the background, there is heavy draped fabric, shelves with books, and a table with books and papers.

artworks.title: Louis, Duke of Burgundy
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after François de Troy
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, turned slightly to his right. He has a youthful face with long, curly hair flowing past his shoulders. He is wearing ornate historical aristocratic clothing, including a decorated coat with a lace collar showing. He has a sash with a star-shaped medal over his shoulder, indicating high rank. The man is in an oval frame with a plaque below it reading "Louis Duc de Bourgogne" in elaborate script. The background is plain with engraved lines.

artworks.title: Gedeon Berbier-Du Metz
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to his right, with long curly hair framing his face. He has a long nose, deep-set eyes, and full lips. The man is wearing a dark robe and a light-colored scarf or cravat with a tassel. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval-shaped border with intricate patterns. In the background, there are fine parallel lines.

artworks.title: Mary, Princess of Orange
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait showing the upper body of a woman. She is positioned with her body slightly turned to the side, gazing outward towards the viewer. Her facial features are delicate and symmetrical, with large, expressive eyes and a serene expression. Her hair is styled in a voluminous and curly manner, cascading down her shoulders and adorned with decorative elements. She is draped in an ornate garment that appears to be a luxurious fabric, with detailed folds and a decorative clasp. A string of pearls is around her neck. The background features an oval frame design with intricate line work.

artworks.title: Mary, Princess of Orange
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a woman, depicted from the torso upwards. Her head and shoulders are slightly turned to her left. She has a composed expression with evenly arched eyebrows, delicate features, and full lips. The woman's hair is styled in loose, voluminous curls that fall around her shoulders and are adorned with a string of pearls. She is wearing an ornate dress with a high neckline trimmed with lace and decorated with intricate embroidery and patterns. The dress features puffed sleeves with decorative elements on the shoulders. Around her neck is a pearl necklace. The background consists of an oval-shaped frame filled with a patterned design. The image includes decorative script beneath the oval frame denoting the subject's title and attributes.

artworks.title: William II, Prince of Orange
artworks.artist: William Faithorne
artworks.description: The image is a half-length portrait of a young man identified as "William, Prince of Orange." He is facing forward with his head slightly turned to his left, looking directly at the viewer. His features are delicate and youthful, with large eyes and full lips. His hair is long, wavy, and shoulder-length. He wears an elaborate outfit with a lace collar and a detailed coat. The portrait is framed with an oval border against a hatched background, and an inscription at the bottom identifies him as "William, Prince of Orange."

artworks.title: Thomas Bruce, Earl of Elgin
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with long, wavy hair past his shoulders. He has a serious expression, and wears a dark cloak with a light inner layer and a wide, white collar. His right hand is resting on his cloak near his chest. The portrait is encased within an oval frame with intricate designs. An inscription below the portrait names him as Thomas, Earl of Elgin and Lord Bruce, along with a coat of arms featuring a coronet and figures. The background inside the oval frame is finely cross-hatched, with additional embellishments in the surrounding rectangular space.

artworks.title: Lord Thomas Fairfax
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Robert Walker
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a man with long, wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He is facing forward in a three-quarter pose, wearing detailed and ornate period armor. The armor includes metal plates covering his shoulders and chest. The background consists of cross-hatching lines forming an oval frame around the subject. There are no visible accessories, jewelry, or objects in the image. A caption beneath the portrait identifies the man in a formal or authoritative position.

artworks.title: John Milton
artworks.artist: William Faithorne
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man in a classic portrait from the chest up, facing slightly to the left but looking directly at the viewer. He has a serious expression, long, narrow face, and long, wavy hair with a middle part that drapes over his shoulders. The man is dressed in period-appropriate clothing with a collared shirt and wide, thick collar common in the 17th century. He is wrapped in a garment that suggests a cloak or large wrap. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background features a detailed, oval engraving surround with intricate linear patterns, typical of historical portraiture. Details around the border indicate the creator and the date as 1670, with the name "Ioannis Miltoni Effigies" at the bottom, suggesting this is a portrait of John Milton.

artworks.title: John Mordaunt, Viscount Mordaunt
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Robert Walker
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man in armor with long hair, a firm expression, and a white collar. The ornate frame includes a heraldic border with various crests, swirling patterns, and ribbons. The script at the bottom identifies the man as "Giovanni Viccaro Mordant, Constable of the Royal Castle of Surrey."

artworks.title: Margaret Smith
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a woman facing slightly to her right, with wide-set eyes, a small nose, and a smile. She has curly shoulder-length hair and is wearing a detailed garment with a scoop neckline, pearls, and pearl earrings. The background has an oval frame with an engraved pattern. Below the portrait, there is an inscription with her name and additional text.

artworks.title: Etienne Pasquier
artworks.artist: Léonard Gaultier
artworks.description: The image shows an older man in a portrait. He is facing slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a curly gray beard covering his chin and jawline, with a mustache. He wears a cap on his head, a dark robe with a high collar, and a lighter-colored undergarment visible at the neckline. There is an intricately designed oval frame in the background with floral embellishments on the corners, featuring drawn flowers and leaves and surrounded by text in Latin. The style suggests this is an engraving or etching, with detailed line work throughout.

artworks.title: Lady Catherine Howard
artworks.artist: Wenceslaus Hollar
artworks.description: The image shows Lady Catharina Howard, a young girl, in a portrait against a plain, textured background within an oval frame. She is facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. Lady Catharina Howard has delicate facial features with large, wide-open eyes and a small, rounded nose. Her hair is styled in tight, curly waves framing her face and pulled back with a comb or headpiece. She wears a dress with a striped pattern on the bodice, a decorative brooch, and a light fabric over her shoulders, which could be a shawl or outer garment. She also wears a pearl necklace. The background is simple, focusing on the figure without additional elements or scenery.

artworks.title: Jacob Cornelius
artworks.artist: Frederik Hendrik van den Hove after Cornelis Visscher
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated from the waist up, facing slightly left with his gaze directed at the viewer. He has a round face with expressive eyes, a prominent nose, a slight mustache and beard, and curly hair receding slightly at the temples. He wears a buttoned-up garment typical of formal attire, with a visible collar. He holds a rolled-up booklet or document in his hand. On the table beside him are documents, an anatomical drawing, and an inkwell. The background is a dark, textured oval framing the man. Text borders the artwork, providing historical and descriptive context.

artworks.title: Gabriel Chassebras de la Grand'Maison
artworks.artist: Pierre Lombard
artworks.description: This image depicts an engraved portrait of a man from the upper chest upwards. He has long wavy hair, a groomed mustache and goatee, a straight nose, and prominent cheekbones. He is wearing a dark garment with intricate button detailing and a white collar with pointed tips. Surrounding him is an oval frame with inscribed text. Below the frame is a heraldic shield with decorative elements. The background is patterned.

artworks.title: Cardinal Fleury
artworks.artist: François Chereau I after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man shown from the chest up. He is seated, looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and medium-length wavy hair. He is wearing a robe with a wide collar and intricate detailing. The oval frame encloses the portrait with an inscription around it. Below the oval is a decorative coat of arms with heraldic symbols. The background is textured.

artworks.title: Henry, Count de Bergh
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man shown from the chest upwards in formal attire. He has a full beard and mustache, curly receding hair, and is wearing a possibly military-style outfit with a lace collar. The background features an oval frame with fine horizontal lines and the inscription "SPES IN DEO SOLO." Below the oval is ornate text related to the subject.

artworks.title: William Louis, Count of Nassau-Beilstein
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man. He is positioned slightly facing his left while looking at the viewer. He has a well-groomed beard and mustache, with short hair. His facial features are rendered in a classic portrait style, giving him a composed expression. He is wearing elaborate clothing with intricate patterns, a large lace collar, and buttons on the shoulders. The background is dark, highlighting his clothing and facial features. The portrait is encased within an oval border, with surrounding text.

artworks.title: Florent II, Count of Pallandt
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man with curly hair, a short beard, and a mustache. He is wearing a richly adorned garment with a lace ruff around his neck and a decorative chain over his shoulders. The background features a dark oval frame with partially visible text at the top and elegant script at the bottom.

artworks.title: Catherine, Countess of Pallandt
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person shown from the chest up. The individual is facing the viewer and positioned slightly to the side, with their head turned forward. They have a soft facial expression, with full cheeks and a slight double chin. Their hair is curly, shoulder-length, and dark, framing their face. The person is dressed in a richly detailed garment featuring decorative elements, such as lace and ribbons, with dark beads forming a necklace-like ornament across their chest. The background is a textured surface, likely part of the engraved frame around the oval portrait, which also includes some text around its border and below the image.

artworks.title: Hendrik Matthias, Count of Thurn and Taxis
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body. He is facing the viewer with a composed expression. The man has distinctive facial features, including a high forehead, arched eyebrows, piercing eyes, a prominent nose, a full beard and mustache. He has short, curly, receding hair. He is wearing an ornate garment with intricate patterns and a high collar. The background is oval with Latin text "ANIMA LIBERTA" around the subject. Text in both Latin and German is present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Fine de Brianville
artworks.artist: Pierre Drevet after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The man's upper body, including his head and shoulders, is depicted in a three-quarter view within an oval frame. The person faces slightly to the right, appearing serene with distinct facial features. His attire consists of elaborate clerical garments and a pectoral cross. The background features fine details and a decorative coat of arms.

artworks.title: Leonard de Lamet
artworks.artist: Pierre Drevet after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the knees up, seated in an ornate chair. The person is positioned sitting upright, facing forward. The individual has a mature face with distinct features, such as a broad forehead, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a slight smile. Their hair appears to be wavy and of medium length. The person is wearing formal attire with long, flowing robes and a large, square cap on their head. The attire seems to be made of a heavy, luxurious fabric, possibly silk, and includes a visible band of ruffled material at the neck. The image is a detailed engraving or etching. The person is holding an object in their hands, possibly a scroll or letter. The background of the image features drapery and an architectural element, such as a column.
